source: The canonical MDE project-goal catalogue. The Workbench reads this to let the user PICK a goal (not free-text); the goal loop and docs reference the same set. Prose form: .mde/docs/reference/guides.md.

goals.title: Establish the Foundation for Customer Review
goals.objective: Establish the foundation for customer review — business requirements, scope, terminology, core business rules, and an initial design or prototype.
goals.description: Define the business requirements, scope, terminology, core business rules, and initial design or prototype. Give the customer something concrete to review before committing to the complete application.

goals.title: Build the First Usable Release
goals.objective: Build the first usable release — the minimum end-to-end application that delivers the core business value.
goals.description: Implement and verify the minimum end-to-end application that delivers the core business value. The objective is a working application, not merely a collection of technical components.

goals.title: Introduce Customer-Driven Enhancements
goals.objective: Introduce customer-driven enhancements — apply feedback, improve workflows, and add the most important missing capabilities.
goals.description: Apply customer feedback, improve workflows, and add the most important missing capabilities. Align the application more closely with how the customer actually works.

goals.title: Prepare the Application for Production
goals.objective: Prepare the application for production — security, access control, performance, reliability, deployment, monitoring, and operational support.
goals.description: Strengthen security, access control, performance, reliability, deployment, monitoring, and operational support. Make the application safe and dependable for production use.

goals.title: Expand Business Capabilities
goals.objective: Expand business capabilities — secondary workflows, reporting, notifications, integrations, and more advanced business rules.
goals.description: Add secondary workflows, reporting, notifications, integrations, and more advanced business rules. Extend the application's business value beyond the initial release.

goals.title: Optimize the Business Experience
goals.objective: Optimize the business experience — usability, automation, efficiency, analytics, and maintainability based on actual usage.
goals.description: Improve usability, automation, efficiency, analytics, and maintainability based on actual usage. Make the application easier to use and the supported business processes more effective.
